newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH KOMERCNI APPROVES CZK 101 GROSS DIV.
newsitem.headline: CZECH KOMERCNI APPROVES CZK 101 GROSS DIV.

text.p: Shareholders of the largest Czech commercial bank, Komercni Banka a.s., voted on Monday to pay out a 101 crown dividend per each 500 crown share on 1996 earnings, the CTK news agency reported.
Officials at the bank were not immediately available to comment on the report.
The bank paid a 95 crown gross dividend per share on 1995 profits.
Komercni has said that the date of share posession entitiling the shareholder to a dividend payment would be June 25.
The bank posted a 5.24 billion net profit last year, after 5.11 billion in 1995, according to international accounting standards.
Under Czech accounting standards, the bank's net profit was 5,36 billion in 1996, after 5.16 billion in the previous year.
A government privatisation agency, the National Property Fund, holds a 48.8 percent stake in the bank.
Komercni shares, which are traded on the main marekt of the Prague Stock Exchange, rose nine crowns on Monday to 1,810.
